newsitem.title: USA: Burger King expects to spend $300 million in U.S. ads.
newsitem.headline: Burger King expects to spend $300 million in U.S. ads.

text.p: Fast food giant, Burger King said Tuesday it is boosting its U.S. advertising spending by more than 10 percent and expects to spend at least $300 million in promoting its hamburgers in the coming year.
"Our advertising budget has grown by double digits for the last three years," said Paul Clayton, worldwide marketing chief for Burger King, a unit of Britain's Grand Metropolitan Plc.
He said the company's U.S. restaurants run by franchisees were likely to spend an additional $40 million more on marketing and promotion during the fiscal year ended next Sept. 30.
Promotional spending will also increase in Europe, Clayton said. Outlays there should be about five percent of Burger King's targeted $1 billion in European revenues, he said.
